title: Sound with the Web Audio API
when: The app needs sound effects, tones, a metronome, simple synth notes or a volume control without audio files.
prompt:
Goal: Clean sounds from one AudioContext started by a user gesture, with envelopes that avoid clicks and a mute control.
Steps:
1. Create one AudioContext lazily on the first click or key press and call resume() there.
2. Route everything through a master GainNode to destination; mute and volume change only master.gain.
3. Tone: OscillatorNode into a GainNode; ramp gain from 0.0001 to peak in 10 ms and back with exponentialRampToValueAtTime, stop after the ramp.
4. Rhythm: schedule on ctx.currentTime, looking ahead 100 ms every 25 ms, never with setTimeout alone.
5. Samples: decodeAudioData once, cache the AudioBuffer, play a new AudioBufferSourceNode each time.
6. Persist the mute choice and pair important sounds with a visual cue.
Quality bar:
- No clicks at note starts or ends.
- Moderate default volume (master gain near 0.3).
- Nothing plays before a user action.
Pitfalls:
- A new AudioContext per sound.
- Restarting a stopped oscillator, which throws.
- Information carried only by sound.
Verify:
- [ ] Single context created on a gesture.
- [ ] Master gain with a mute control.
- [ ] Gain ramps on start and stop.
- [ ] Mute button labeled with aria-pressed.
Output: js/audio.js exporting init, playTone, playSample and setMuted.

examples.input: adiciona um som de acerto e erro no quiz
examples.output: audio.js with playTone(880) for right, playTone(220, square) for wrong, master gain mute toggle
